d01_ton.style: very soft, to himself, greeting the sea at dawn, a small content smile

d02_mai.style: out of breath after running in the rain, talking to her broken umbrella, starting to laugh at herself

d03_ton.style: kind, a little shy, calling gently from a warm doorway in the rain

d04_mai.text: Thank you. Sorry, I'm dripping all over your floor.
d04_mai.style: grateful, a bit embarrassed, still breathless, smiling

d06_ton.text: Here. Something warm... a little sweet.
d06_ton.style: quiet and caring, setting down a glass of hot tea

d07_mai.style: warm, relaxed, breathing in the steam

d09_ton.style: quiet, a small smile in the voice

d10_mai.style: soft, after the first sip of hot tea, eyes closed

d11_mai.text: Is it always this quiet out here?
d11_mai.style: soft and curious, watching a storm over the sea through the window

d12_ton.text: Mostly. Just the sea... and the kettle.
d12_ton.style: quiet, gentle, unhurried, a little amused

d14_mai.style: delighted, soft surprise, the rain has just stopped and gold light comes out

d15_ton.text: It usually does, out here. By evening.
d15_ton.style: calm, quiet, looking out at the sea

d16_mai.text: I should go, before it changes its mind.
d16_mai.style: light, playful, getting up from her seat

d17_mai.text: I don't think it's going to make it.
d17_mai.style: fond, rueful little laugh, looking at her wrecked umbrella

d18_mai.text: Would you keep it for me? So you'll remember the rain.
d18_mai.style: warm, gentle, a little wistful, smiling at the door

d19_ton.style: very quiet, moved, a soft smile

d20_mai.text: Thank you for the tea, Ton!
d20_mai.style: calling back cheerfully from a distance outside, walking away down a pier

d21_mai.style: warm, familiar, a little playful, stepping in out of the rain

d22_ton.style: quiet, warm, a smile you can hear
